templates.title: Water Storage Reset
templates.description: Rotate, relabel, and restage household water so the stored supply stays trusted and usable.

items.text: Pull the oldest labeled drinking-water containers first
items.detail: Start with the containers that would be consumed soonest anyway.

items.text: Inspect seals, odors, cloudiness, and storage damage
items.detail: Set aside anything you no longer trust before it mixes back into storage.

items.text: Refill or replace daily-use containers before deep storage
items.detail: Keep the most-reached-for water easy to trust and easy to grab.

items.text: Relabel every refilled container with date and intended use
items.detail: Separate drinking use from utility use.

items.text: Restage a small grab-fast water set near the exit path
items.detail: Make sure it matches how your household would actually leave.

items.text: Update the Inventory tab with current counts and notes
items.detail: Close the loop so the shelf and the app still match.
